name: reviewer-2
description: Peer-review a scholarly article note as a separate review copy - anchored critique callouts on gaps, evidence, logic, theory, and structure, each carrying its fix and citations resolved against real research runs, plus a ranked meta review and revision plan.

tools.name: reviewer_2
tools.description: Index an article note into anchorable blocks; validate agent-authored review comments against the article and its linked web-research runs (anchors, verbatim quotation, resolvable citations, hedging where only an abstract was read); review them with the thinking model; and render a review copy in '00 Inbox' that interleaves comment callouts with the article body reproduced byte for byte, followed by a meta review, a step-by-step fix plan, generated references, and provenance. Proves the rendered copy strips back to the original body before writing anything. Creates new files only and is inspectable with status/doctor.
